title: Cap on gaming machines in each venue (Queensland)
summary: The Gaming Machine Act 1991 (Qld) limits the gaming machines a licence may fix for a venue to the maximum prescribed for its category of premises.
direction_rationale: A cap on the number of machines each venue may run.
